title: Review the strategy against results
summary: Check regularly whether the bets are working. Use evidence, compare plans with what actually happened and learn before deciding what to change.

beginner: Set a regular review, such as every quarter.
Collect results for each bet against its measures.
Compare what happened with what you expected.
Note what you learned, good and bad.
Share a short review with the sponsor.
intermediate: Look for patterns across bets, not just single results.
Separate bad luck from bad assumptions.
Bring teams' learning into the review.
experienced: Review the whole portfolio, including stopped bets.
Be honest about missed targets rather than explaining them away.
Use the review to update the next planning cycle.

toolExamples.power-bi: Show results for each bet on one dashboard.
toolExamples.confluence: Write a short review page each quarter.

pitfalls: No link to the next plan
